title: User Sign Up with Email and Password
description: Verify that a new user can successfully sign up using a valid email address and password, and receives a confirmation or welcome message.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-up page
Input a valid email address and a secure password
Submit the registration form
Verify user is redirected to a welcome or dashboard page
Verify user record is created in the database

title: User Login with OAuth Provider
description: Verify users can authenticate via supported OAuth providers successfully and that sessions are properly created.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Select an available OAuth login option (e.g., Google, GitHub)
Complete OAuth provider login flow
Verify user is redirected to dashboard after authentication
Verify user session token is issued and accessible

title: Forgot Password Flow
description: Verify that users can request a password reset link and reset their password successfully via email.

steps.description: Navigate to the forgot password page
Input a registered email address and submit
Verify password reset email is sent with valid link
Click password reset link and input a new valid password
Verify user can login successfully with new password

title: Create AI Voice Agent with Custom Settings
description: Verify that users can create a new AI voice agent with custom LLM and TTS configuration and scripts.

steps.description: Login to user dashboard
Navigate to create agent page
Fill in agent details, upload or input custom script, select LLM and TTS options
Submit to create agent
Verify agent appears in user's agent list with correct settings

title: Inbound Call Handling via Twilio with Accurate STT and AI Response
description: Verify real-time processing of inbound voice calls through Twilio integration including speech-to-text conversion and AI-generated voice responses.

steps.description: Place an inbound call to the Twilio assigned number
Verify call is received and routed to the AI voice agent
Verify real-time speech from caller is converted to text via Deepgram STT
Verify AI (Groq LLM) generates an appropriate response
Verify response is converted back to speech with selected TTS voice
Verify call flow follows designed script and conversation logic

title: Lead Extraction and CRM Integration
description: Verify that AI correctly extracts lead information from conversations and delivers it to configured CRM systems.

steps.description: Complete a call session qualifying a lead with relevant data
Verify extracted lead data matches conversation content
Verify lead data is transmitted and accepted by CRM integration endpoint

title: Free Trial Usage Tracking and Quota Enforcement
description: Verify that free trial usage is correctly tracked and enforced, preventing usage beyond quota limits.

steps.description: Start a free trial account
Perform calls until trial quota is reached
Verify usage metrics update correctly in dashboard
Verify subsequent calls are blocked or notified due to trial quota exceeded

title: Payment Processing and Subscription Activation through Flutterwave
description: Verify end-to-end payment process for subscription plans using Flutterwave including payment link generation, successful payment, webhook handling, and subscription status update.

steps.description: Generate payment link for a subscription plan
Complete payment through Flutterwave interface
Verify payment success webhook is received and validated
Verify user subscription status updates to active

title: Dashboard Analytics Display Accuracy
description: Verify that the user dashboard accurately displays real-time analytics including call usage, agent performance, and billing information.

steps.description: Login to user dashboard
Verify analytics data matches backend metrics for calls and usage
Verify billing section shows current subscription and payment status

title: API Rate Limiting Enforcement
description: Verify that the platform enforces configured rate limits to prevent API abuse and returns appropriate error responses when limits are exceeded.

steps.description: Send API requests in rapid succession exceeding rate limit policy
Verify API returns rate limit exceeded error codes
Verify further requests remain blocked until rate limit window resets

title: API Key Management and Authorization
description: Verify only authorized API keys with valid permissions can access protected endpoints and that unauthorized keys are rejected.

steps.description: Attempt API call with valid API key
Verify API call is successful and authorized features are accessible
Attempt API call with invalid or revoked API key
Verify API call is rejected with authorization error

title: Webhook Signature Validation for Secure Event Handling
description: Verify that incoming webhooks from third-party integrations (e.g., Twilio, Flutterwave) are validated using signature checks before processing.

steps.description: Send valid webhook request with correct signature
Verify webhook is accepted and processed
Send webhook request with forged or missing signature
Verify webhook is rejected and logged as suspicious

title: System Health Check Endpoint Validation
description: Verify that the health check API endpoint correctly reports system uptime, component status, and critical performance metrics.

steps.description: Send request to system health check API endpoint
Verify response contains accurate uptime and component status
Verify any system errors are reported with log references

title: Admin Panel User Management Functions
description: Verify that administrators can create, update, and manage user accounts and monitor system health from the admin panel interface.

steps.description: Login as admin to the admin panel
Create a new user account from admin interface
Verify new user is created and appears in user list
View system health metrics via admin dashboard
Verify displayed data matches system monitoring data

title: Chat Widget AI-Powered Real-Time Messaging
description: Verify that the embedded chat widget provides AI-generated responses with low latency and maintains conversational context.

steps.description: Embed chat widget on a test web page
Send messages via the chat widget
Verify responses are generated by Groq AI and contextually relevant
Verify response latency is within acceptable limits

title: WhatsApp Integration for Notification Delivery
description: Verify that WhatsApp messaging integration successfully sends notifications and updates to customers.

steps.description: Trigger a WhatsApp notification event (e.g., lead status update)
Verify WhatsApp message is sent to the intended customer number
Verify message content matches intended notification

title: Error Handling and UI Feedback on API Failures
description: Verify that the UI components properly handle and display error messages when backend API calls fail or return error states.

steps.description: Simulate API failure (e.g., network error, 500 response) during user action such as agent creation
Verify UI shows appropriate error message or notification
Verify error state does not leave UI in inconsistent or unusable state

title: Text-to-Speech Voice Option Selection and Playback
description: Verify users can select among multiple TTS voice options and that generated audio responses implement the selected voice accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to TTS voice selection page or agent configuration
Select each available voice option in turn
Trigger voice generation with sample text input
Verify output audio matches the selected voice characteristics

title: Session Expiry and Logout Behavior
description: Verify user sessions expire as expected and that logout functionality clears session tokens preventing further access without login.

steps.description: Login as a user and use the system normally
Trigger session expiry manually or wait for timeout
Verify user is redirected to the login page when making further requests
Perform logout action explicitly
Verify session tokens are invalidated and further access requires login

title: Documentation and Support Accessibility
description: Verify that users can access documentation, FAQ, privacy policy, terms of service, and contact pages, and that AI chat support is functional.

steps.description: Navigate to each documentation and support related page
Verify content loads correctly and is comprehensive
Use the support AI chat widget to ask a question
Verify AI assistant returns relevant and helpful responses
